Counsel for Respondent :- Anjali Upadhya,C.S.C.
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Kshitij Shailendra,J.
1.

The prayer made in the instant petition is for a direction to the State-respondents to provide all benefits of rehabilitation and resettlement to the petitioners in accordance with the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as 'the Act').
2.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The petitioners have sold their land to the respondents for D.M.I.C. Project by sale deed dated 30.11.2017.

Those persons who had not agreed to transfer their land to the State-respondents on Chainpal And 7 Others vs State Of Up And 8 Others on 13 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/35107788/
1 basis of mutual agreement were compelled to part with their land on basis of compulsory acquisition followed by award dated 01.07.2022.

entities.text: Chainpal And 7 Others vs State Of Up And 8 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The petitioners claim that although, they had transferred their land by sale deed but they are also entitled to rehabilitation and resettlement benefits as per the provisions of the Act.
Their representation made before the Greater NOIDA Authority, it seems, was put up for consideration in the Board meeting and the Board decided to seek guidance from the State Government.

Consequently, on 19.01.2024, the Additional Chief Executive Officer, Greater NOIDA sent a communication to the Principal Secretary, Industrial Development Department, U.P.,
Government, Lucknow for opinion of the State Government on the matter.
3. The submission of learned counsel for the petitioners is that the State Government has not taken any decision in the matter so far.
It is urged that the State Government be directed to take appropriate decision.
4. Learned State Counsel as well as Ms. Anjali Upadhya, appearing for Greater NOIDA have no objection to the same.

5. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the petition is disposed of with direction to respondent No.2 to take appropriate decision and communicate the same to the Greater NOIDA in pursuance of the communication dated 19.01.2024 sent by the Additional Chief Executive Officer within twelve weeks from the date of communication of the instant order.
